notes:
SOCIAL PANEL

Open friends and conversations from menus, deck building, or a match. Search friends, view profiles, keep message history and drafts, and see unread messages or pending requests on the collapsed panel. Game invitations use compact accept and decline controls and wait until you return to a main menu if you are already playing.

PLAY AND ROOMS

Refined full-bleed Leader artwork, deck information, queue and match counts, display settings, navigation colors, room controls, rule scrolling, and the resizable public-table browser.

UPDATER

The update screen now keeps the complete release notes inside a responsive scrollable panel with a visible scrollbar whenever the notes overflow.
